attempt.hypothesis: The complete immutable attempt corpus through Campaign 11 accounting reconciles exact record, PASS, non-pass, timeout, wall-time, and namespace totals.
attempt.scope: Compute cross-campaign program accounting through C11-CLOSE-002 before terminal prose and workflow records append.
attempt.rollback: Correct prose totals from immutable JSON without rewriting attempt history.

command: import collections,json,pathlib; ps=sorted(pathlib.Path('docs/experiments/attempts').glob('*.json')); ds=[(p,json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))) for p in ps]; groups=collections.defaultdict(lambda:{'attempts':0,'pass':0,'nonpass':0,'wall_s':0.0}); [(groups[p.name.split('-')[0]].update(attempts=groups[p.name.split('-')[0]]['attempts']+1,pass=groups[p.name.split('-')[0]]['pass']+(d.get('execution',{}).get('status')=='PASS'),nonpass=groups[p.name.split('-')[0]]['nonpass']+(d.get('execution',{}).get('status')!='PASS'),wall_s=groups[p.name.split('-')[0]]['wall_s']+float(d.get('execution',{}).get('wall_time_seconds') or 0)) for p,d in ds]; print(json.dumps({'through':'C11-CLOSE-002-accounting-final','attempts':len(ds),'pass':sum(d.get('execution',{}).get('status')=='PASS' for _,d in ds),'nonpass':sum(d.get('execution',{}).get('status')!='PASS' for _,d in ds),'timeouts':sum(bool(d.get('execution',{}).get('timed_out')) for _,d in ds),'wall_time_seconds':sum(float(d.get('execution',{}).get('wall_time_seconds') or 0) for _,d in ds),'groups':dict(sorted(groups.items()))},indent=2)); assert len(ds)==sum(d.get('execution',{}).get('status')=='PASS' for _,d in ds)+sum(d.get('execution',{}).get('status')!='PASS' for _,d in ds)
